title: SaaS launch film — blank page to growth

source.author: @DanielSmidstrup
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the ClimbX launch film; structure and pacing follow it, brand, logo, product copy and numbers are ours and fictional.

scenes: dot grows into a flag, mountain logo draws itself
orange blank page: floating empty composers, hook question
iris close, flash, logo lockup with particle burst
logo flies into the app sidebar, quick tour of three pages
counter to 10 ready posts, idea cards stack, click Edit
editor: typed line, post rating bars, Ready to post badge, schedule click
week calendar receives the post, zoom out to the month
night scene: engage card, reply sent, notification pills
final lockup with stats and CTA
